prose: Matt Presti is the president of the University of Science and Philosophy. We discuss self-discovery and divinely inspired illumination by exploring the ideas of thinkers like Walter Russell, Nikola Tesla, and other spiritual avatars of history. His eclectic artistic expressions range from musical masterpieces to video presentations, and that's just the tip of the Presti-burg.
topics: The Divine Illumination of Walter Russell
Integrating horizontal sensing with vertical knowing
The illusory nature of the motion universe
Channeling music from dreams into recorded track
ext: Why "raising your vibrations" is more dangerous than enlightening
